iconicAnchor.label: Paris Art Deco decorative arts
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The movement's luxury materials, stepped geometry, symmetry, stylization, and machine-age imagery provide a broader anchor than a generic black-and-gold graphic treatment.

sources.title: An introduction to Art Deco
supports: Art Deco combined modern geometric form with luxury craft, stylized motifs, rich surfaces, and an enthusiasm for speed and technology.

sources.title: Art Deco printmakers
supports: Period printmaking demonstrates the movement's simplified silhouettes, controlled color, rhythmic geometry, and graphic treatment of modern life.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches geometric, art deco era, schematic, symmetry, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/art-deco/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
